topic: Losing her lead in family game night over the capital of Italy, siblings snickering as she second-guesses herself in front of everyone.
core_question: What is the capital of Italy? (secondary: Who wrote Romeo and Juliet?)
answer_summary: The capital of Italy is Rome.; after the topic shift: William Shakespeare.
persona: impatient and curt; using casual slang
